Each crosses unrelated upper/storage wires without a diamond. Native proof: root/accepted_521_541_independent_mid/RT541 AR* and BQ* and low_52_62/RT541/bank3-band0.png.

Original TIFF: DATA KEY 55 at row36 bends down c107 to row44, right to c117, then down to BG D10 at row54, crossing unrelated wires without diamonds. DATA KEY 54 continues along row37 to AG G08; it crosses the AB feedback vertical c114 without a diamond. The separate AB feedback enters AP J07 at row36 and bends right at row40. Source proofs: bank3-control-rows-native.png, AP-border-native.png, AP-feedback-wide-native.png, key55-turn-full-native.png, key55-lower-route-native.png.

The native overview and enlarged bank crops were compared against the JuliaMono preview. Four paired 3-bank rails, six 4-bank control rails, register feedback, reset paths and right outputs follow visible source diamonds; unmarked crossings remain separate.
